title: ingest.object.created payload (v1)
description: Payload of the ingest.object.created outbox event. Producers (shapes vary genuinely): app/services/vault_sync.py (uuid/title/review_state/content/path), app/api/routes/ingest.py::insert_object_and_outbox (raw ingest request body: uuid/title/review_state/content/origin/trust/source_ref), app/objects/__init__.py::ObjectStore.save_object (minimal uuid/kind only). Consumer: app/workers/outbox_worker.py::handle_ingest_object_created (app/services/indexer.py), which reads every field via .get() with defaults. This schema pins the known field shapes and stays open for producer-specific extras; nothing is hard-required so the minimal object_store producer stays valid.

uuid.description: Canonical lifecycle object id for vault_sync events.

vault_uuid.description: Retained frontmatter continuity identity when available.
